High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard o n I.A.No.1848/2023, which is the second/repeat application filed under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the appellant Bheru Singh.
2. His first application-I.A.No.14922/2021 was dismissed on merits by this Court vide order dated 21.10.2021.
3. The appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376-D of the IPC and sentenced to undergo L.I. along with fine and default clause.
4. Counsel for the appellant has submitted that as on today the appellant has suffered the actual sentence of nine years and three months and with remission around 15 years.

Counsel for the appellant has drawn the attention of this Court to a recent order passed by the Supreme Court in Special Leave to Appeal No.2886/2023, Arjun Vs. State of MP, dated 20.03.2023 where the petitioner had incarcerated for around eight years without remission and with remission,
approximately ten years.
Thus, it is submitted that the present case is on a better footing.

5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that the appellant's earlier application has already been dismissed on merits, however, it is not denied that the appellant has suffered actual incarceration of nine years and three months.

6. On due consideration of submissions, on perusal of the record and considering the actual sentence suffered by the appellant and relying upon the decision rendered by the Supreme Court in the case of Arjun (Supra) and further considering the fact that appeal is not likely to be heard at an early date, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, IA No.1848/2023 is allowed and it is directed that upon depositing fine amount and on furnishing a personal bond by the appellant in Bherusingh @ Bhuriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23634298/

sentences.text: the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, for his regular appearance before concerned trial Court, the execution of the custodial part of the sentence imposed against the appellant shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this appeal.

7. The appellant after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the concerned trial Court on 30.10.2023 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the concerned Court in this regard.
